title: Agent, assistant and automation: where the difference lies

videos.script: This course is about programs that act. Up to now a model has answered you. Here it starts choosing what to do next. {{title}} Three words get mixed up all the time: automation, assistant and agent. They are not three levels of cleverness. {{three}} The difference is one question. Who decides the next step? In automation, the programmer decided, long before the program ran. With an assistant, a person reads the answer and decides. In an agent, the model decides, one step at a time, inside a loop. {{who}} You will run all three on the same customer message, in the course's lab. A script that follows a fixed path. One call to a model that writes a draft. And a loop that looks up the order, searches the help centre and answers. {{lab}} Then you will take the agent apart. A model, tools, a loop, the conversation so far, and a rule that makes it stop. {{parts}} One warning, before anything else. The model in this lab is a stand-in. Its replies were written by the course. Everything around it is real, and that is the part you will build. {{standin}}
